display_long_description:
Agent Oops! is the cooperative Mixed Reality party game for 1-4 players that redefines how we play together! Charles is known as “the world’s greatest spy”... but only because you’re there to save him: without your help, he wouldn't last five minutes! 
[media]
Use the Spymatic 5000 in your room, which becomes an active part of the action! Deactivate deadly traps and lasers, avoid dangers, and use spy tools to help Charles: use a giant hair dryer to defrost devices, slice through obstacles with a katana, or use the X-Ray device to see through a storm! Crouch down to avoid detection or move to dodge a geyser: your body is part of the mission!
[media]
👥 1-4 player co-op: Playable solo, online, or in local co-location (same room) for a revolutionary experience.

🖐️ Hands Enhanced Gameplay: Play without controllers! Includes unique mechanics and interactions thanks to  hand tracking.

🛠️ Level Editor: Create, share and play your own custom levels.

🏠 Spy Base: Build and customize your headquarters between missions.
[media]
With 11 worlds to explore, over 180 unique levels, and the ability to create your own missions, Agent Oops! is a dynamic, chaotic, and social experience. Can you make the world believe that Charles is a true legend?
